title: kate-ui: map visual rows to lines around collapsed folds
summary: rows_to_lines returns the logical line for each visual row from a first line, skipping the lines that a collapsed fold hides. The header line of a fold stays visible. The fold packets in the window call it.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. The file has no GPUI import, but kate-ui tests run in the rust (macos-15) job and the Mac lane owns crates/kate-ui.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add rows_to_lines with #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]. Walk line from first_line; when a collapsed span has header equal to line, push line and jump to end + 1; otherwise push line and add one; stop when the result has rows entries or line reaches line_count. A span whose header is below first_line and whose end is at or past first_line hides the lines up to end. The test rows_to_lines_skips_a_collapsed_fold uses line_count 10, span (2, 5), first_line 0, rows 4, and asserts [0, 1, 2, 6]; with first_line 3 it asserts [6, 7, 8, 9]; with no spans and rows 3 it asserts [0, 1, 2]. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: layout::tests::rows_to_lines_skips_a_collapsed_fold
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because rows_to_lines does not exist. After the change the hidden lines 3 to 5 are skipped and a start inside the fold jumps past its end.
